description.value: Superflux Beer Company is a craft brewery and taproom nestled between Strathcona and East Vancouver, specializing in IPA with a rotating selection of lagers and pale ales. The brewery operates an on-site taproom with a food menu, a covered patio open daily, and an off-sales counter selling cans to go. A touring cyclist stopping here can grab beer and snacks and pick up packaged beer to take along.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 4m; stands at 8m; stands at 13m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Superflux is an active brewery and taproom at 505 Clark Drive, Vancouver, BC V5L 3H7, with off-sales (cans to go) and a food menu, matching the OSM tags for bar and alcohol shop. The business name on the website is consistently 'Superflux Beer Company', not 'Superflux Beer Store' as in OSM — this is flagged as a concern. No bike parking, washroom, water, or Wi-Fi amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Superflux Beer Store' but the business consistently identifies itself as 'Superflux Beer Company' across all website pages.
OSM address is missing the house number; website confirms full address as 505 Clark Drive.
Minor postcode discrepancy on /home subpage (V5L3H6) vs. V5L 3H7 on all other pages and OSM — likely a typo on that one subpage.
No phone number present in OSM or on website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active brewery and taproom with off-sales, open seven days a week; useful stop for touring cyclists seeking refreshments and packaged beer.

wow_evidence: covered patio open daily... off-sales counter selling cans to go
